retained_sources.description: J.A. Vandehey, 'A general theory of (s,t)-core partitions', thesis, University of Oregon, May 2008; arXiv:0809.2134. Theorem 2.4 (Maximal Theorem) + Sections 4-5: FIRST complete proof of containment in the maximal (s,t)-core for all coprime s,t. PROOF-BODY level.

M. Fayers, 'The t-core of an s-core', arXiv:1007.1071; published JCTA 118 (2011) 1525-1539, DOI 10.1016/j.jcta.2011.01.004. Section 5, Theorem 5.1 + Proposition 5.5: independent peer-reviewed complete proof, literal statement '[lambda] subseteq [kappa_{s,t}]'. PROOF-BODY level.

A. Aggarwal, 'A Converse to Vandehey's Theorem on Simultaneous Core Containment', arXiv:1408.0550v1. Abstract confirms: 'Vandehey showed that there exists an (a,b)-core that contains every other (a,b)-core as a subpartition when gcd(a,b)=1.' Abstract/body-level confirmation of resolution status.

M. Thiel, N. Williams, 'Strange Expectations', arXiv:1508.05293v1 (31 pp.). Theorem 1.3 remark: 'A stronger statement is actually true: J. Vandehey proved that the diagram of this unique (a,b)-core maximizing size contains the diagrams of all other (a,b)-cores [Van08, Fay11] [OS07, Remark 4.11].' Bibliography identifies [Van08] and [Fay11].
